description: Change what a visitor with no account sees and may do on a table's public page. Pass only what the person asked for. The answer says CHANGED / UNCHANGED per setting and, in plain words, what anyone with the link can do now — tell the person that sentence when a switch opened their records. The page's login and password are never arguments: switching password_database_boolean on makes them when the page has none, and the answer carries a link to a page that shows them to the owner once.

settings.description: setting: true | false. allow_database (the page shows the records), allow_search (a search box; with the records hidden — a search-only page that shows what was found), add_new_record (an «add a record» button), allow_database_edits (visitors change records), allow_delete (visitors delete records), allow_database_records_clone (visitors copy a record), allow_export (export to a file), allow_pdf (save as PDF), allow_grouping, allow_pagination, hide_links (links as plain text), password_database_boolean (the page asks a login and a password)

name: update_public_page
